ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'
name: wetterdienst
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: wetterdienst
  version: "0.133.0"
  python_min_exporter: "3.11"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 524df0998a5b19710fc6113b4c3e7faac54d5aef717c2cb6a687f3a4a0b15d59


build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}
    build:
      noarch: python
      script:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir -vvv
      python:
        entry_points:
          - wetterdienst = wetterdienst.ui.cli:cli
          - wddump = wetterdienst.provider.dwd.radar.cli:wddump
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - uv-build >=0.9.21,<0.13.0
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }},<4.0
        - aiohttp >=3.14.0,<4
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python <3.11)
        - backports-datetime-fromisoformat >=2
        - certifi >=2024.2.2
        - click >=8.2,<9
        - cloup >=3.0.1,<4

        - fsspec >=2024.6

        - lxml >=4.9.1,<7
        - measurement >=3.2,<4
        - platformdirs >=4,<5

        - polars >=1.43.0,<2
        # start polars[calamine]
        - fastexcel >=0.9
        # end polars[calamine]

        - portion >=2.4.2,<3
        - pyarrow >=22.0.0
        - pydantic >=2.7.3,<3
        - pydantic-extra-types >=2.10.1,<3
        - pydantic-settings >=2.7.0,<3
        - python-dateutil >=2.8.2,<3
        - rapidfuzz >=3.1,<4
        - diskcache >=5.6.3,<6
        - stamina >=25.1.0,<27
        - tabulate >=0.9,<1
        - tqdm >=4.64,<5
        - typing_extensions >=4.15.0,<5
        - python-tzdata >=2024.2
        - tzfpy >=0.15.2,<2
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - script:
          - wetterdienst --help

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-bufr
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pdbufr >=0.10.2,<1
        - pybufrkit >=0.2,<1
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  # sqlalchemy-cratedb not on conda-forge
  # - package:
  #     name: ${{ name }}-with-cratedb
  #   build:
  #     noarch: python
  #   requirements:
  #     host:
  #       - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  #     run:
  #       - python >=${{ python_min }}
  #       - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
  #       - pandas >=2,<4
  #       - sqlalchemy-cratedb >=0.40,<1
  #   tests:
  #     - python:
  #         imports:
  #           - wetterdienst
  #         pip_check: true
  #         python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-duckdb
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - python-duckdb >=1,<2
        - pandas >=2.2.2,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-eccodes
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - python-eccodes >=1.5.2,<3
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-excel
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - xlsxwriter >=3.0.9,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  # this has been dropped upstream but is still needed
  # here for python 3.10 support
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-export-without-zarr
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pandas >=2.2.2,<4
        - sqlalchemy >=2,<3
        - xarray >=2024.6,<2027
        - xlsxwriter >=3.0.9,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  # this is only available for python >= 3.11, where the
  # require zarr version is available
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-export
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min_exporter }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min_exporter }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pandas >=2.2.2,<4
        - sqlalchemy >=2,<3
        - xarray >=2024.6,<2027
        - xlsxwriter >=3.0.9,<4
        # tightest of upstream's floors (python >=3.11)
        - zarr >=3.1,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min_exporter }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-knmi
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - h5netcdf >=1.7.3,<2
        - h5py >=3.11,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-influxdb
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - influxdb >=5.3,<6
        - influxdb-client >=1.18,<2
        - influxdb3-python >=0.3,<1
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-interpolation
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - scipy >=1.14.1,<2
        - shapely >=2.0.4,<3
        - utm >=0.7,<1
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-matplotlib
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - matplotlib-base >=3.3,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-mcp
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - wetterdienst-with-restapi
        - fastmcp >=3.4.4,<4.0.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-mysql
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - mysqlclient >=2,<3
        - pandas >=2.2.2,<3
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-pdf
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pypdf >=3.12.1,<7
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-plotting
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - python-kaleido >=1.0.0
        - plotly >=6.1.1
    tests:
      - python:

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-postgresql
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - psycopg2 >=2,<3

          pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-radar
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - h5py >=3.1,<4
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - wetterdienst
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-radarplus
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pybufrkit >=0.2,<1
        - wradlib >=2.0.1,<3
        - xradar >=0.2,<1

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-with-restapi
